style: Trashy panic-pop, two competing reference pitches creating aggressive microtonal beating. Akan Twi-influenced Akan/TWI phonology transfer, high-dimension click system and huge consonant palette. Harmony: bitonal modal drone with chromatic side-steps and unstable intervals. Melody: angular cabaret patter with glottalized vowel leaps, lexical tone pressure, and frantic pitch bends. Rhythm: can't sit still motorik pulse with asymmetric footstep group-stomp density and pneumatic air releases. Timbre: dry hand claps, finger snaps, tongue clicks, heavy breathing, and toybox physical hits. Ensemble: leader plus distorted echo group shouting counterpoint. Production: trashy cheap spectacle with raw close-mic body percussion and saturation artifacts.
